blocs.en: A <mark class='k-key'>52-year-old female</mark> has presented with a <mark class='k-signo'>painless preauricular swelling on the right side of her face</mark> that has been developing over the past year.

items.fr: Masse intraparotidienne droite <mark class='k-sign'>ovalaire, bien limitée</mark>, prédominant dans le <mark class='k-tech'>lobe superficiel</mark>, en <mark class='k-signo'>isosignal T1</mark> et en <mark class='k-signo'>signal T2 hétérogène</mark>, avec des <mark class='k-sign'>plages en hypersignal T2 correspondant à des zones myxoïdes</mark>.
items.en: Right intraparotid ovoid, <mark class='k-sign'>sharply marginated</mark> mass predominantly in the <mark class='k-tech'>superficial lobe</mark>, exhibiting <mark class='k-signo'>isosignal on T1-weighted imaging</mark> and <mark class='k-signo'>heterogeneous signal on T2-weighted imaging</mark>, showing <mark class='k-sign'>hyperintense areas consistent with myxoid areas</mark>.

items.fr: En coronal T2 FS : <mark class='k-sign'>capsule périphérique en hyposignal</mark>.
items.en: Coronal T2 FS reveals a <mark class='k-sign'>peripheral low signal intensity capsule</mark>.

items.fr: Diffusion et cartographie ADC : <mark class='k-sign'>diffusivité augmentée, ADC élevé</mark> (ADC : 1,8 × 10⁻³ mm²/s).
items.en: Diffusion-weighted image and corresponding ADC map demonstrate an <mark class='k-sign'>increased diffusivity with high ADC values</mark> (rADC: 1.8 × 10⁻³ mm²/s).

items.fr: T1 FS après gadolinium : <mark class='k-signo'>rehaussement hétérogène</mark>.
items.en: <mark class='k-signo'>Heterogeneous enhancement</mark> on T1-weighted fat-suppressed MRI following gadolinium administration.

items.fr: Injection dynamique : <mark class='k-sign'>rehaussement progressif</mark> <mark class='k-sign'>sans lavage</mark>, courbe de type A.
items.en: <mark class='k-sign'>Progressive enhancement</mark> following dynamic gadolinium injection <mark class='k-sign'>without wash-out</mark>, following a type A enhancement curve.

items.fr: <mark class='k-key'>Tumeur bénigne de la parotide la plus fréquente</mark> chez l'adulte.
items.en: <mark class='k-key'>The most common benign parotid gland tumor</mark> in adults.

items.fr: Le plus souvent dans le <mark class='k-tech'>lobe superficiel</mark>.
<mark class='k-sign'>ADC plus élevé que celui des autres tumeurs parotidiennes</mark> (1,3 à 2,2 × 10⁻³ mm²/s).
items.en: <mark class='k-sign'>ADC values higher than other parotid tumors</mark> (1.3–2.2 × 10⁻³ mm²/s).

items.fr: <mark class='k-grave'>Transformation maligne</mark> rapportée jusqu'à <mark class='k-grave'>15 %</mark> en l'absence de traitement : <mark class='k-grave'>carcinome ex-adénome pléomorphe</mark>.
items.en: <mark class='k-grave'>Malignant transformation</mark> reported up to <mark class='k-grave'>15%</mark> if left untreated: <mark class='k-grave'>carcinoma ex pleomorphic adenoma</mark>.

items.fr: Signes de malignité : <mark class='k-grave'>contours infiltrants</mark>, <mark class='k-grave'>multicentricité</mark>, <mark class='k-grave'>hyposignal T2</mark>, <mark class='k-grave'>ADC < 1,2</mark> (× 10⁻³ mm²/s).
items.en: Signs of malignancy: <mark class='k-grave'>infiltrative margins</mark>, <mark class='k-grave'>multicentricity</mark>, <mark class='k-grave'>hypointense T2 signal</mark>, <mark class='k-grave'>ADC value <1.2</mark> (× 10⁻³ mm²/s).
